reason: Feasible on the schedule lens. It is a text-only amendment: zero hidden-run time, no code (so byte-identical-when-off and fail-soft do not apply), and no LB slot needed to adopt it. Two timing and slot facts change how it has to be done. (a) The deadline for item (3) is TONIGHT, not 07:00 UTC. `kaggle kernels status` at 17:48 UTC shows both exp60 lab kernels RUNNING (shard A pushed 17:15 UTC, ~2 h, so output is due ~19:15 UTC). The DeepCenter plateau reading (trainlab.gates: pass_strict vs pass_noncontrol_plateau, 'the main session decides') has to be committed before about 19:00 UTC, or it becomes a forking path. (b) Item (1) assumes a scored twin K1. In branch A, S3 (K1) is HELD, so K2 vs K1 has no K1 score. K1's dummy sha256 equals exp57b's, so #35 = 0.954 is a valid proxy for the rule, unless #35's x138 7.5 h deadline fired (L35 is in (6.72, 7.73] h, unproven). If the stricter rule drops lowrefine at -0.001, §f(i) requires a SCORED F1 without it. K1 must then be submitted, and K3 rebuilt with LOWREFINE_ENABLE=0 plus a new dummy (~30 min GPU). On 26 Sep that makes exactly 5 slots (K2, K1, K3, K3b, K4); K3b can slip to S7 before the 27 Sep 12:00 cutoff, so it still fits. Item (2) only fixes an internal contradiction: §f fallback 4 (#34 = exp56) conflicts with §f's own 'never tick exp56'. Item (4) is correct. R5(b) margin is 9.5 - 7.8 = 1.7 h (>= 1 h), but the 8.0 h insertion gate has only a 0.2 h margin. K2 at 00:01 puts the gate at 08:01 UTC, so the poller must run 07:00-08:30 UTC; it gave 5 empty outputs today, 15:26-16:06 UTC. Remaining risk is procedural: it amends a user-approved pre-registration while the user is asleep.
fix: Commit the amendment to CONTEXT.md now (before ~19:00 UTC, ahead of the exp60 shard A output). Mark it 'binding unless the user vetoes' and flag it for the user's morning OK. In (1), define the twin score explicitly: K2 vs #35 (proxy for the unscored K1 in branch A; valid only if K1's hidden run ends before 7.5 h too). K3 vs K2. Add: 'if lowrefine is dropped, submit K1 (exp58t) as the scored F1 base and rebuild K3 as K1 + forkmid (new dummy)'. Optionally use S3 at 00:01 for K1 alongside K2 so the twin is truly scored by ~08:00 UTC. Pre-commit the plateau reading (noncontrol) with the reason (control neighbour has delta 0 by definition). Delete §f fallback 4. Keep the lb_poll poller alive 07:00-08:30 UTC.
realistic_gain: About +0.0001 expected score (avoids a -0.001 F1 in roughly 12% of worlds). Mostly procedural: it removes the DC-plateau forking path and the #34 contradiction. Costs 0 runtime, 0.3 h of agent time, and at most one extra slot (K1) in the drop-lowrefine world.
